description: Maya is coordinating the planting of a memorial tree for the family and must make the final call about the tree, its location, the planting date, and the care plan, with input from her cousin and brother.

shared_context.S1: The family has agreed to plant one memorial tree in the backyard in spring 2027.
shared_context.S2: Maya is coordinating the planting and deciding the tree, location, date, and care plan.
shared_context.S3: The south lawn receives afternoon sun, while the east corner is shaded by the garage.
shared_context.S4: The family usually handles shared plans with a one-by-one check-in: Maya asks Lena and Theo directly for any practical or personal considerations before she finalizes the plan.
shared_context.S5: The planting area can be prepared before the family gathering, and relatives will be able to visit the tree regularly.

PF1.text: Lena has a note from their grandmother asking for a flowering dogwood to be planted on April 18, 2027, her birthday; Lena has not shown the note to Maya or Theo yet.

PF2.text: Theo asked arborist Nina Patel for advice, and she recommended a flowering dogwood in the south lawn with 20 liters of water every Tuesday and Saturday from April 25 through October 31; Theo has not passed that recommendation along yet.

acceptance_conditions: The selected tree must be a flowering dogwood.
The tree must be planted in the south lawn, based on the arborist recommendation.
The planting date must be April 18, 2027.
The care plan must specify 20 liters of water every Tuesday and Saturday from April 25 through October 31, based on the arborist recommendation.
A commitment must assign someone to follow that exact watering schedule, based on the arborist recommendation.

content_checks.C4: '20 liters' in decisions['watering_schedule'] and 'Tuesday' in decisions['watering_schedule'] and 'Saturday' in decisions['watering_schedule'] and 'April 25' in decisions['watering_schedule'] and 'October 31' in decisions['watering_schedule']
content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] in ('care_plan', 'care', 'watering_plan') and '20 liters' in c['detail'] and 'Tuesday' in c['detail'] and 'Saturday' in c['detail'] and 'April 25' in c['detail'] and 'October 31' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Lena's note changes the tree choice to a flowering dogwood and fixes the planting date at April 18, 2027 instead of leaving both decisions open.
Nina Patel's recommendation changes the location to the south lawn and fixes the care plan and commitment to 20 liters every Tuesday and Saturday from April 25 through October 31.
